rule_or_pattern: Replace Cyrillic look-alikes in recipe enumerators with Greek: 'Г' (U+0413) -> 'Γ', and any other Cyrillic capital standing alone before '.' or ':' (А->Α, В->Β, Е->Ε) in this book. Additionally drop lines flagged C:cpp_vs_book_out together with C:cph_out_of_range (crop and label are from different lines), and lines starting with a digit followed by '......' ('1......' is a misread italic recipe letter).
notes: This is a pharmacopoeia: polytonic prose, Latin/French drug names and numbered index entries all read correctly (1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 9-20, 23, 27, 30, 32-34, 36-40), and the digit/OOV flags are genre. The other-script residue is Google writing the recipe letter 'Γ.' as Cyrillic 'Г.' (8), a fixable substitution. A few crops are mis-segmented: 6 is mostly the line above with a partial label, 25's label runs past the crop, 35's label skips 'Poudre de'. The italic enumerator 'Α......' is read as '1......' in 24, and in 3 the dose '5' is read as 'ὁ'.
